How it works

Skin to sale, in four steps.

The same scan-to-sale flow works on your website, in store and on WhatsApp.

Step 1

Scan

A ninety second face or body scan, on any surface you already run.

Step 2

Analyze

Oyster analyses the image for skin concerns across every skin tone.

Step 3

Match

Every concern maps to the right products from your own catalogue, checked by a human aesthetician.

Step 4

Sell

Customers move from their scan results to matched products, then to checkout.

Questions people like you ask.

How accurate is it on dark skin?↗
98.9% accurate on Fitzpatrick IV to VI. Most skin-analysis models are trained mostly on lighter skin and fall apart on melanin-rich tones. Ours is trained on the largest melanin-rich dataset in commercial AI, so a customer with deep skin gets an analysis that is just as precise as anyone else's.
Do we need any hardware or an app?↗
No hardware, and nothing to install. The customer scans on her own phone: she opens a QR code or taps a button on your site, the camera analyses her skin, and the results come back in about 90 seconds. In-store, the same scan runs on a shared tablet at the counter.
How is this different from a skin quiz?↗
A quiz asks the customer to describe her own skin, and people guess wrong more often than not. The scan measures it directly, analysing 100+ biomarkers from the photo. That accuracy shows up in sales: scan-guided shoppers buy at around 75%, while ordinary browsing converts at 1 to 2%.
How long does it take to go live?↗
The scan widget drops onto your existing store in under two hours, no engineering sprint required. If you want the full Retail OS, with payments, inventory and CRM connected, that is a matter of days, and our team sets it up with you.
Does it work with Shopify or WooCommerce?↗
Yes. There is a JavaScript widget for Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento and any web platform, a React Native SDK for your mobile app, and a full REST API and MCP server if you want to build something custom. Most partners are live on the widget the same day.
Where does our customer data live?↗
Data is stored in-region and aligned to POPIA and NDPR. Consent comes first: the customer approves every scan, owns her own images, and can withdraw at any time. You get the insights; she keeps control of her face.
What do we actually get to see?↗
A match score for every product against each customer's skin, concern and skin-tone trends by store, city and region, and restock timing driven by real demand. You never see a customer's raw images unless she has explicitly consented to share them.
What does it cost?↗
You pay per guided customer, so the cost tracks the value you get, and the per-scan price drops as your volume grows. The full price list is public, with no setup fee and no long lock-in to start.
